title: Designing Context for Reliable Agents
description: Practical guidance for helping agents find relevant evidence, use it correctly, and verify their work. Informed by research on context, skills, and long tasks.

title: Checkpoint Replay for Long-Horizon Agent Evaluation
description: Evaluate a 24-hour soak at recorded checkpoints. Restore the evidence and agent state available at each moment, then test the decisions.

title: Local Context for Autonomous Agents
description: Put telemetry, logs, and topology beside the agent. Use PromQL and files to keep retrieval reliable and model context focused.

title: Trustworthy Autonomy
description: Nine principles for systems that deserve the authority we give them. A field guide to evidence, boundaries, and learning from consequences.

title: Engineering Autonomous Agents
description: An agent’s capabilities depend on its data, execution loop, state, and feedback. Design them as one system.

title: Verdicts require Epistemics
description: Trustworthy Autonomy · An autonomous agent investigates 5XX errors—and learns to separate what it observes, what it believes, and what it can safely do next.

title: Evidence requires Provenance
description: Trustworthy Autonomy · A precise number can tell the wrong story. Follow a claim back through the query, the cohort, and everything the summary left out.

title: State requires Ownership
description: Trustworthy Autonomy · The editor canceled a translation job. A late agent report says it is running. Which version of reality gets to win?

title: Autonomy requires a Dial
description: Trustworthy Autonomy · A coding agent can inspect a repository, prepare a patch, or merge it. Each action needs its own grant of authority.

title: Inputs require a Trust Boundary
description: Trustworthy Autonomy · A log line says the deployment is pre-approved. How does the system keep an observation from becoming an order?

title: Knowledge requires a Clock
description: Trustworthy Autonomy · The dashboard is accurate. It is also describing a world that has already changed. Truth needs a time boundary.

title: Delegation requires Ceilings
description: Trustworthy Autonomy · Every helper makes a reasonable request. Together, they overwhelm the system they came to investigate.

title: Failure requires a Ladder
description: Trustworthy Autonomy · When the agent loses its instruments, what should it give up first? Design the descent before the incident.

title: Learning requires Outcomes
description: Trustworthy Autonomy · An invoice extractor passes its sample test. The next day, the accounting team finds incorrect totals. Who grades the original claim?

title: Focus
description: Agent systems, data and context, evaluation and learning.

title: Ideas in progress
description: Open questions about agent environments, context, replay, and reusable engineering.
